scope: One change at a time on the four production Mage reference requests (validation/2026-10-04-mage-census/bases, application revision 18bbcd47): every talent at its maximum or removed, every mage armor option, every spell the pinned Go Mage registers cast from the top of the rotation, alone and with the talent that grants or changes it, every other Mage race, and the pinned reference's Mage rotation and talent presets on its P0 and P1 gear sets, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust.

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: The two rejections are community fix #622: an auraIsActive condition names an aura the build no longer has once Missile Barrage or Fingers of Frost is removed, which the pinned reference drops and #622 reads as inactive.
The launch gear preset is left out: its item 276765 panics in the pinned Go engine.
